user.title: Sign in to Atomberg
user.description: Use your Atomberg Home email and password. Session tokens reconnect automatically after restarts. Enable Remember password to sign in again if token renewal fails. The saved password is stored in Home Assistant configuration and backups; leave disabled to save tokens only. Social login and MFA are not supported.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials and complete verification in the Atomberg app.
error.no_devices: No supported Wi-Fi fans were found in this account.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the account already configured for this integration.

init.title: Automatic sign-in
init.description: Session tokens already survive restarts. Remember password allows automatic sign-in if token renewal fails. Your password is stored in Home Assistant configuration and backups, without additional encryption by this integration. Leave the password blank to keep an existing saved password. Turning this off removes it from the current configuration.

error.password_required: Enter your password to enable automatic sign-in.
